notes.title: Youtube devlogs and a second demo!
notes.notes:
Hello steam! Long time no see, huh? 

I've noticed that some of you haven't really followed us on any other platforms besides here. So I want to inform you that I've just posted the third devlog of the game on YouTube, which you can check out here :
[previewyoutube=lojHmQ_A4ug;full]https://www.youtube.com/@streetlightstudio2901
[/previewyoutube]

Additionally, I want to state that the game is still in development, and we are currently working on the second level of the game—the mall. We anticipate having a playable demo around mid-2024. You can check out its development here: 
https://twitter.com/streetlightteam

I'll try to be more active here aswell! If you have any questions let me know! 

Okay bye, love yall!
